title: Towards Trust Calibration in Socially Interactive Agents: Investigating Gendered Multimodal Behaviors Generation with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Generating multimodal behavior transcripts using LLMs with explicit male/female agent prompts versus neutral prompts, and applying Random Forest classifiers with SHAP value analysis to detect gender-stereotypical associations in generated non-verbal behaviors (e.g., associating male agents with high ability/confidence and female agents with high benevolence/uncertainty).
